title: Mall World Reoccurring Dream
content: So my mall world has multiple levels reached by escalators, on the ground floor there is a Disney store for whatever reason but it’s not great and a few other stores, and then the next floor up is more like a department store that goes up a few levels and has a big book store, it’s all quite beige but nice. From the ground floor there’s a second escalator you can take up to the cinema, which is like a long strip of desks and doors into different screens, in there there’s another small escalator that goes up to an American food shop where you can buy all these amazing snacks. There’s another part which is like a good court and sort of resembles a service station, there’s Starbucks and so on and a cupcake shop where I’ve tried to hug cupcakes so many times but they only ever have the worst ones left over when I get to the front of queue, and I don’t even like sweet snacks. Then there’s the toilets. There’s loads of them, but they’re all disgusting and dirty and busy. The floors are always wet! I’m never really there for any specific reason I’m just wondering around 😂
